blocks.text: After the fair, the Bandais openly demand half the offerings and half-control over the sacred institutions, while the Khalsa rejects both their claim and their confidence.
The dispute becomes formal and hard, moving away from whispers into explicit competing demands over the Panth’s visible center.
Half the offerings is the strongest anchor because money, shrine control, and legitimacy are fused in that demand.
